responsibility: Implements the pass that diagnoses problematic uses of alloca and VLAs. It classifies allocation sites as definitely or possibly too large, zero-sized, unbounded, or appearing in loops, uses ranger-derived SSA ranges and target-adjusted warning limits to refine size judgments, distinguishes VLA-specific handling from raw alloca calls, and emits the corresponding -Walloca-larger-than or -Wvla-larger-than diagnostics.
